name: io.github.icedracon/aidrive
title: AIDrive
description: Versioned files, evidence-linked memory and governed handoffs through a local AIDrive API.

environmentVariables.name: AIDRIVE_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: URL of your running local AIDrive API. Start and set up the API separately.

environmentVariables.name: AIDRIVE_WORKSPACE_ID
environmentVariables.description: Workspace UUID issued by your local AIDrive setup.

environmentVariables.name: AIDRIVE_AGENT_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Workspace-scoped agent key issued by the owner. Supply at runtime.
